notes.text: Feature: Preview the selected map in the Draft / Comp Builder.
Feature: Read dated updates for deployed features on the Changelog page.
Feature: Select maps by preview and search, or close the picker with its X button.
Bug fix: Change the map of a comp and keep its draft bans and saves.
Feature: See features and bug fixes labeled in the Changelog.
Feature: First recorded release. Place heroes on maps and draw positions and rotations with undo and redo.
Feature: Build and save team comps. Import and export saved comps, download comp images, and open comps on the Position Board.
